title: WARSZAWA
notes: IMG_5417 and IMG_5416 carry a street musician (sustained notes in A and D major, A = 437-439 Hz, +20-30 dB over the noise in 16k-point spectra). Under the organ score and through the kitchen glass that would be a second, unrelated music, so every city bed is detoned: sustained tonal lines are pulled down to the noise floor around them (tonal prominence 20.9 -> 11.9 dB, the noise baseline; footsteps, voices' breath and the air are kept).

The kitchen clips' tracks have mains hum (50/100/150 Hz, +17-36 dB) and appliance lines (100, 161, 179, 223, 299, 401 Hz): notched at 50-250 Hz and detoned. IMG_5421's handling knock (src 4.02-5.02) and a tick at src 19.93-20.33 are replaced by clean material of the same clip. IMG_5422's own track is not used at all.

Speed: the clips' own sound follows the cue sheet's speed curve (0.8x, 0.5x, eased ramps) through rubberband, pitch kept; library textures under the slow motion are laid on the same curve (rate 1.25: real speed where the picture is at 0.8x, 0.625x in the 0.5x stretch). Nothing is slowed by resampling; only the drips and two set-downs are pitched (by resampling, to make them smaller or heavier) and they are not time-locked to frames.

Set-downs: the glass server is Mixkit 3148 (a glass jar touching down, 888 Hz glass ring); the metal kettle on its base is Mixkit 2934 pitched down 2 semitones (a dull contact) - the brief's 3148 for the kettle and 2933 for the server were swapped for material that matches what is set down. The cup on the stone sill is 2933.
turn_away -> sill: the catalogue has no cloth rustle; nothing is added (the street runs on, continuous).

The score is placed at 0 if its file exists at mix time; its gain is set so that the city stem sits 8 dB under it at the climax (window climax-0.5 .. climax+2.5); it is faded out from end+0.25 to end+1.35 so that the city is the last sound.
